title: ModuleScaffoldService
responsibility: Run existing Harness scaffold workflows for a module-declared generator.

inputs.name: ModuleScaffoldService.generate.root
inputs.description: Project directory passed to the selected scaffold workflow as its root for project detection and file generation. The service forwards this string unchanged.

inputs.name: ModuleScaffoldService.generate.resource
inputs.description: Module resource containing the generator declaration. The service proceeds only when generator.kind is scaffold; a scaffold value of model selects generateModel, and every other declared scaffold selects generatePiece with its level.

inputs.name: ModuleScaffoldService.generate.request
inputs.description: The service forwards name as the scaffold name and group as the optional responsibility-group identifier. If omitted, group is passed as undefined.

outputs.name: ModuleScaffoldService.generate
outputs.description: Resolves to the path strings from the delegated workflow’s write results, in workflow order. The returned array includes skipped paths and omits write status, file contents, and export-update metadata.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: The service throws a plain Error with message 'A scaffold generator is required.' when resource.generator?.kind is not scaffold; native errors from delegated filesystem operations also propagate through the promise.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Delegated generators reject with ExpectedCliError for invalid names or group identifiers, mismatched component levels, ineligible project/scaffold combinations, ambiguous group selection, duplicate grouped names, or refused overwrites. The service propagates these failures as promise rejections.
